title: Naughty
overview: To secure custody of her son from her ex, Mallory's only hope is to find Santa Claus and convince him to testify in her divorce hearing.

title: Elegy to a Missing Friend
overview: In the aftermath of her friend's passing, an artist processes her grief by making a film. She weaves her personal archival footage and an unfinished science-fiction narrative into a deeply raw and emotive work of art.

title: The Fields of Abbottsville
overview: In Ohio, late 2004, after a young religious fanatic Joshua Tinsman (Brennan Abbott) celebrates his 18th birthday. He is then forced into committing crimes by his preacher Ron Tinsman Jr. (Aaron Hickman) that he doesn't want to follow through on. Years of indoctrination and influence from his friends discourages him from leaving. After all, it's the ideology that he and his childhood friend Stephen grew up with since birth. How can you leave something you spent your whole life working towards? Loosely based on a true story.

title: Paranormal Activity 8
overview: The eighth installment in the franchise. Plot TBA.

title: The Nightingale
overview: The lives of two French sisters are torn apart by the onset of World War II.

At 8:38 PM, May wakes up in a room with no memory. With one lifeline call, she must uncover the truth, before it’s too late. But is the voice helping her… or hiding something darker? 8 minutes is all she has.

title: 'Tis the Season
overview: Two wealthy children hold a washed-up mall Santa hostage as their Christmas Eve spirals into chaos.

title: A Grand Biltmore Christmas
overview: In 1895, Elizabeth meets Michael, a teen trespasser at Biltmore House who vanishes. When he returns 20 years later, a magic hourglass pulls her to the present. She must return home before being found and before love alters her destiny.

title: Zero A.D.: The Birth of Christ
original_title: Zero A.D.: The Birth of Christ
overview: A star rises over Bethlehem as Christ is born. But when Herod orders the slaughter of the innocents, Mary and Joseph must protect the child promised to save the world.

title: Holiday Ever After: A Disney World Wish Come True
original_title: Holiday Ever After: A Disney World Wish Come True
overview: Lindsey and her extended family head to Walt Disney World to spend a magical Christmas together, but the dream of a jolly holiday gets quickly dashed when Lindsey discovers her room is next door to Philip, a disastrous first date she recently had, who’s also there on a family trip. As Lindsey and Philip’s paths cross throughout their stay, the frost starts to thaw as they learn they’re not so different from each other after all. Thanks to some Walt Disney World magic, the holiday wish Lindsey made in Cinderella Fountain just might turn their rivalry into romance.

title: Malvina
overview: Malvina is an angel sent to earth for being ignorant of it's problems. she falls to earth and after an incounter with a grieving mother seeks adamentley the love she talks about. when receiving this love finally she becomes addicted. she is filled with so much love for everyone she eventually loses herself completely in the desires and wants of everyone around her.

title: Daffy Season
overview: Daffy is ready for Duck Season, but Elmer is too immersed in his new obsession – soccer – to come hunting. Slowly the world around Daffy turns into a zombie-esque nightmare as the Tunes become obsessed with the sport.

title: Bullet and Lace
overview: Bullet and Lace, a neon-soaked, Giallo-inspired nightmare, follows a young woman whose favorite true crime podcast becomes the voice of the masked intruder stalking her through the night.

title: Dolioo
overview: Sarah Jamson, daughter of Hudson’s murdered ally, wages a one-woman war against Hudson, using stealth, strategy, and vengeance-marked corpses to haunt him psychologically. Chloe Varenne, a symbol of lost love and innocence, becomes the spark that pushes KAEL toward rebellion.

title: My Undesirable Friends: Part II - Exile
original_title: My Undesirable Friends: Part II - Exile
overview: A group of Russian independent journalists flee the country and navigate life in exile after the invasion of Ukraine, focusing on their dispersed lives and ongoing struggle for truth across different nations. While Part I documented their lives in Moscow facing mounting pressure from the Putin regime, Part II chronicles their forced displacement and new realities in various countries, continuing their mission against authoritarianism.

title: Jeffrey Dollmer
overview: Models on a photo shoot are stalked by a doll possessed by the spirit of serial killer Jeffrey Dahmer.

title: The Fall of Barsisa
overview: A modern re-imagining of the fable of the same name. Three brothers leave their ailing sister in the company of a devout and honourable figure as they are guided by an ambiguous stranger through treacherous terrain in search of a remedy.

title: Robbin' the Hood
overview: Two brothers are roped into a scheme to rob from the rich and give to the poor, only to find their victims are not who they think they are.

title: The new advocate
overview: An unspecified future: humanity has vanished from planet Earth. A printer, set to automatic mode, keeps reproducing a short story by Franz Kafka featuring Bucephalus, the horse of Alexander the Great. Will this final message from humankind reach the surviving forms of life? Or will it be nothing more than words lost to the wind?

title: Isolation
overview: Isolation explores loneliness, grief, loss, and the struggles of mental health. All within a pursuit of understanding one's purpose. It's a coalescence of one's trauma and working through it while performing at a high level.

title: The Next Shift
overview: In efforts to try and fit in with his new classmates, Wesley decides to join a couple of them on a night out that leads to a crime that may change the course of his life.

title: Moonfish
overview: A grieving astronaut who's lost his only companion on a deep-space mining mission must fulfill a strict corporate quota to return home. As his year of solitude passes, his grip on reality unravels the line between the living and non-living.

title: Zero Intention of Living Quietly
overview: Mistreated by people unable to cope with his unique visible difference, actor Adam Pearson glimpses a path away from isolation through his love of cinema. Upon meeting kindred spirit Ellie - a girl who shares his genetic condition, NF1 - their quest begins to forge a new type of movie hero, and finally press play on life.

title: I Constantly Thank God for Esteban
original_title: I Constantly Thank God for Esteban
overview: Home alone on the eve of her First Communion, 12-year-old Carmen receives an unexpected visit from a trio of neighborhood roller girls and scooter boys. While at her home, the kids make Carmen painfully aware of her religious upbringing, ultimately stealing her First Communion dress, culminating in a final showdown at their local roller rink.

title: Hauntshow
overview: The twisted final broadcast of an underground variety show. A mysterious, macabre, deviant and delinquent double-bill of chillers hosted by Hauntrella, Hauntressa and the dearly departed Hauntiana.

title: Brandon & Haider
overview: When the enigmatic allure of two ancient artifacts is unleashed, two students are bestowed with unparalleled powers. Yet, a relentless collector, driven by an insatiable thirst for dominion, will stop at nothing to seize them, igniting a cataclysmic battle that will determine the fate of worlds

title: Erased
overview: When confronted by the now 18-year-old son he dismissed before birth, a high-powered businessman must decide between their potential relationship and a life changing financial opportunity.

title: Fork in the Road
overview: Fork in the Road is an intimate documentary that explores the profound connections between people, the land, and the future of our food system. Through a tapestry of compelling stories from independent small-scale farmers across the United States, from Alaskan kelp harvesters to dairy farmers in Kentucky, the film reveals the authentic, lived realities and unprecedented challenges of those working against the tide of escalating industrialization in agriculture. Featuring insights from visionary chefs and culinary experts, Fork in the Road expands the conversation beyond the farm, demonstrating how food sustainability is a shared responsibility that extends into our kitchens and communities. More than a call to environmental action, the film illuminates the vital ways that sustainable food practices can nourish our bodies, strengthen our communities, and heal the Earth.

title: Lengwìa
overview: After an agonizing school year bruises his relationship with his well-liked older brother Jonah, socially awkward Teddy meets Cole, a disarming boy, by chance on the street. As their friendship deepens, actions begin to speak louder than words, unraveling the fragile balance between brotherhood, belonging, and yearning during a blistering summer break.

title: All the Mayor's Men
overview: The rise and fall of a drifter who declares himself mayor of a ghost town inhabited solely by mannequins.

title: Don't Let Me Down
overview: When estranged friends Michael and Elizabeth reunite, Michael finds himself struggling to leave the past behind.

title: Lesbian Ditch Day
overview: Lesbian Ditch Day starts as a rom-com-y, coming-of-age tale of two high school lesbians playing hooky, but through a fourth wall break, the film reveals itself to be just another queerbaiting tragedy.

title: The Pigeon
overview: A bereaved young woman believes her sister has been reincarnated, as a pigeon.

title: Three Black Men
overview: Can blackness escape the violence of its origins?  Three Black men set out on a transformative journey along the transatlantic slave route in reverse, exploring resistance, liberation and a new understanding of Blackness.  Their epic voyage takes them from Los Angeles to Salvador da Bahia in Brazil, and finally to Accra in Ghana. Their mission is to redefine Blackness, heal from historical trauma, and envision new paths to liberation beyond the constraints of white supremacy.

title: Garchaster's Cornblade
overview: A gricky star planet girl follows a casting call into the Earth oven so she can fulfill her dream of getting inside of a VHS tape... to burn and inhale herself. Donald Farmer weaves golden webs with the cryogenic cowboys while the star planet gets heavier with razzling trash carnivals. The Carpet Muckers twirling gorches but the Garbites are way too hungry for karaoke flavored peanut butter screams.

title: South of Seattle
overview: Jane visits an old friend.

title: Borges and Me
overview: Jay Parini finds himself stuck in a Morris Minor, chauffeuring the brilliant, blind Jorge Luis Borges through Scotland. Quiet and conservative, 23-year-old student Parini dreams of becoming a writer but is at a loss to make sense of the wild, irrepressible 70-year-old Borges. As the journey takes a surreal turn, their differences magnify until, in the tradition of a classic road trip, the two ultimately find common ground.

title: Laghdaithe le hAois
overview: A Violent Implosion Of Physical And Exhaustive Energy. An Intensified Requiem For Unsustainable Nights. All That I Hold In My Heart, Diminished With Age, Burning Softly Away Within The Smothered Hours Of Abstraction And Certainty.

title: Frank Skinner: 30 Years of Dirt
overview: Frank Skinner: 30 Years of Dirt is the celebrated stand-up show by British comedy legend Frank Skinner. The acclaimed routine explores his decades-long career, his attempts to perform "clean" comedy (and his subsequent, hilarious failures at it), and his reflections on growing older.

title: The State of Us
overview: Tearaway Frankie breaks out his best friend Taylor for one final night out. Over a riotous few hours filled with laughter, heartbreak and some home truths, the boys will face the ultimate test.

title: Mermaid Beach
overview: Two sisters move with their mother and stepdad to a new town by the sea. As they try to get used to their new home, they make a startling discovery that changes their lives forever.

title: Pen to Paper
overview: A young man struggles to write a legible, heartfelt letter to his mum by hand.

title: Abandoned
overview: Chasing a viral video to save their channel and friendship, two urban explorers break into a derelict facility scarred by sinister experiments. Trapped among its secrets, they enter a nightmare where history manifests as evil.

title: Coconut
overview: Nineteen-year-old bedroom rapper Dev has always been called a 'coconut': brown on the outside, white on the inside. Ashamed of his Australian accent and mocked by community members whenever he speaks Fiji Hindi, he has given up on his family's language. His cultural displacement comes to a head when he accidentally ruins his grandpa's Hindu funeral ceremony, knocking the urn containing his ashes into the nearby creek. Everything changes when his sharp-tongued, non-English-speaking grandma hears Dev swear at a stranger and responds in kind. Their new secret language becomes a bridge across grief and a way back into culture and language.

title: Auckland Law Revue Presents: Pretty Little Lawyers
original_title: Auckland Law Revue Presents: Pretty Little Lawyers
overview: Hit comedy stage show Auckland Law Revue is back for 2026 with Pretty Little Lawyers! A show full of skits, dancing, singing, and everything in between!!  Professors and students are being picked off one by one 😱⚰️. The OBITERROR is here. A ragtag group of students must solve the mystery 🔍 before they become the next victims 🪦. Will they outsmart the masked menace, or get caught in their twisted games? 🩸🤫

title: Sundown
overview: Three generations of women reunite in a remote cabin to avenge a loved one's death, only to discover their captive isn't who he seems to be, and his family is closing in, waiting for sundown.

title: Camp Rock 3
overview: When pop group Connect 3 returns to Camp Rock to search for an opening act for their reunion tour, rising tensions and fierce competition among campers test old friendships and spark unexpected romances.

title: Ever After
overview: A group of girlfriends arrive at a forest lodge to celebrate, but things take a horrific turn as they realize that the forest is home to bloodthirsty lunatics who perceive themselves to be characters from classic fairy tales.

title: Yugly
overview: Yugly, an irresistibly ugly dog, is determined to compete in the World's Best Dog Show, rallied by a bunch of flamboyant strays.

title: SUPER TAKANAKA WORLD LIVE IN LONDON 2026
original_title: SUPER TAKANAKA WORLD LIVE IN LONDON 2026
overview: The world tour performance held at the historic prestigious live venue "02 Academy Brixton" in London, England!  As the heat of city pop reassessment is increasing around the world, tickets are sold out immediately!  A miraculous night in which an audience of five thousand people who filled the venue was enthusiastic about high-middle sound across generations and borders.

title: Unruly
overview: When the responsibilities of tending to a haunted house are forced upon young Sam, she must fight to survive as she completes nightly tasks to keep the unruly spirits in her home satisfied.

title: Down the Arm of God
overview: A young pastor goes through a harsh winter in a small Texas town, where his mission to help the homeless is faced with resistance by his congregation, exposing deep-seated prejudice and systemic failures.

title: Peter
overview: Peter North became the most famous male adult film star in history, but before the fame he was Alden Brown, a young man from Halifax, Nova Scotia chasing Hollywood dreams. When mounting debts to organized crime pulled him into the adult film business, his life took an unexpected turn. For the first time ever, North shares his extraordinary story in his own words, alongside interviews with Jenna Jameson, Ginger Lynn, Christy Canyon and more who help reveal the man behind the legend.

title: Rory Scovel: Show Must Go On
original_title: Rory Scovel: Show Must Go On
overview: With a hypothetical home invasion, a biblical reenactment, and his late dad's final wish, Rory Scovel delivers unrelenting laughs in this raucous stand-up special filmed at The Neptune in Seattle, Washington.

title: The Bigfoot Experiment
overview: A group of vloggers investigate an abandoned research facility, where long-buried secrets transform their search into a desperate fight for survival.

title: Epitaph
overview: Newlywed Anna and her husband relocate to Alaska, but their blissful life takes a dark turn when a car crash causes Anna to develop selective amnesia. The incident triggers agoraphobia and haunting flashbacks.

title: The Assassin
overview: A man guided by his job begins to question his world.

title: Barm IV: Tracks of Blood
overview: Recently widowed barm goes on a wild train ride full of suspense and intrigue.

title: Otter
overview: Bubble, a young otter, lives on an island that had caught on fire. She had swim away to find a new home, she had found a new island that could concur her. But as she becomes aware of their true nature, she has to face her loneliness.

title: Wei Baba
overview: A woman introduces her Chinese dad to her American Jewish boyfriend and manipulates their language barrier to keep everyone happy.

title: Tight Lettuce
overview: A son films his father's addiction, hoping to document his recovery; but as he sacrifices everything to save him, he must decide how much he'll lose for someone who may not want saving.

title: Ice Twister
overview: A family in a mountain cabin faces a deadly ice tornado that blocks escape routes. As the storm tears apart their shelter and tensions rise, they must choose between braving the elements or staying put to face the natural disaster from hell.

title: The Cover Story
overview: Inside an ordinary home, a plastic cover speaks not as waste, but as a ruler. From the smallest household corner, it declares its dominance.

title: Sky to Soil
overview: A young couple with conflicting desires for intimacy attempt to celebrate their one-year anniversary.

title: Sea of Stars
overview: Driving through a sea of stars. The universe is infinite.

title: Blood Mandate
overview: A visceral action-thriller where a lone fighter is forced into a relentless pursuit by a grim ancestral decree. To satisfy a blood mandate that haunts his family's legacy, he must cut through a web of enemies and shifting alliances. As the hunt intensifies, the line between justice and revenge blurs in a raw struggle for survival.

title: Freaks Part II
overview: Several years after a traumatic escape, we meet Mary and her daughter Chloe as they live on the road, hiding their powers and identities. They are hunted by the Abnormal Defense Force, paramilitary police that specialize in ruthlessly exterminating ‘freaks‘ like them. Mary is fueled by revenge, determined to find the ADF officer who killed her first child.

title: Little Miss Fortune
overview: A young journalist must find a story in Belfast before midnight or lose his job.

title: The Messenger
overview: In 1800s Fiji, Kaliti must battle both man & nature to save her village from impending doom.

title: Saliva Agridoce
overview: After years of trying to leave behind the traumas that marked their lives, a couple decides to start over in an old house far from the city. Boundaries between memory, guilt, and the supernatural begin to disappear.

title: Marble Tears Taste Like Wine
overview: A volatile chess prodigy struggling with anger management attempts to navigate a world that feels hostile, dismissive, and chaotic. While chess offers him control and identity, real life repeatedly provokes his buried rage. After fleeting moments of connection and hope, a final altercation spirals into irreversible violence, forcing him to confront the devastating cost of losing control.

title: The Obelisk
overview: While fighting for survival in the wilds of the Northeast, a drifter unites with a mysterious veteran to expose the truth of America’s demise.

title: Larger than Life
overview: A documentary following Connor Sanderson, the inspirational coach of Salisbury Ladies FC. Born with sacral agenesis, Connor has overcome physical challenges to pursue his passion for football, becoming a respected coach and an inspiration to his players and community.

title: EPISODE 12
overview: On June 6th 2023 television show Paranormal Closure was pulled from all broadcast stations. With no statement as to why. Over a year later a video surfaced online claiming to be from the episode that never aired.

title: Scotty
overview: A stray cat (Scotty) has to travel with a pet cat (Katie) despite his desire to return to his territory, but when he gets home, he realizes that living with those he loves is better than living alone.

title: Salieri and Mozart
overview: A young gifted actor rehearses on his own when interrupted by the theater director and bizarrely mistreated. What will he make of it?

title: Comparable
overview: A Writer struggles to tap into his imagination as another, younger Writer shows off in front of him.

title: HANDMEDOWN
overview: An experimental micro-documentary and multigenerational handing down of queer sexual wisdom and whimsy.

title: Friends Like Us
overview: A dark comedic thriller where two sitcom actors have to reenact a new version of their show’s series finale after a crazed fan keeps them hostage.

title: Man Chicken
overview: In this found footage comedy, two brothers go on an adventure to find the urban legend known as "Man Chicken." The trip takes a turn for the worst, as the truth begins to reveal itself, the deeper they travel into the forest.

title: George Michael: The Trojan Souls
overview: The conversation that never finished.  In 1993, Andros Georgiou — lifelong best friend and brother to George Michael — began assembling the greatest collaborative album ever conceived. Eight of the most iconic artists in history all said yes. The album was never made. Until now, the footage has never been seen. This is Trojan Souls — the film that tells the story of what almost was.

title: The Veto
overview: For 80 years, the UN Security Council permanent member veto power has been the subject of constant debate, within the UN and without. The veto itself isn’t going away—it’s ‘veto-proof’. But when vetoes are cast in the face of genocide, war crimes, and crimes against humanity, obligations under international law and the UN Charter must be considered.  Such veto uses have led to massive loss of life, displacement of millions, and the multilateral order pushed to a breaking point.  The film, featuring leading global experts, puts aside ‘the impossibility of change’ and explores real paths to breaking the Security Council deadlock, and avoiding a third global conflict.  This is an urgent film for global audiences — it’s an issue that truly affects us all.

title: RISE
overview: The year is 2099. With the evolution of AI bringing machines to a superior to human intelligence they have lived peacefully and in harmony together. Until now…

title: White Gardenia: The King James Bible
original_title: White Gardenia: The King James Bible
overview: An epic-scaled avant-garde underground project that will cover both the Old and New Testament, featuring segments from various filmmakers and their beautifully extreme visions of the myriad of biblical stories.

title: KING
overview: King, a champion of the fighting organization, lives, trains, and fights under one roof with his roommate Sam. They compete weekly in grueling matches that leave them bruised and battered. Their landlord and promoter promises to get them away from this lifestyle for bigger and better opportunities on the condition that they continue to push themselves for another fight. The roommates face their toughest battles during recovery while pushing each other to continue training for their next bouts.

title: Coconut Valley
overview: A washed-up video game developer reunites with his estranged brother in Thailand in order to chase their late father's dream of uncovering a long-lost treasure.

title: Homo Machina
overview: As a lonely man isolates himself, the line between the digital and physical world blurs.

title: Avatar Aang: The Last Airbender
overview: Avatar Aang, the world's last Airbender, learns of an ancient power that could save his culture from extinction. With the help of his friends, he embarks on a global quest to find it before it falls into the wrong hands and threatens to upend the peace they sacrificed everything to achieve.

title: Home Bodies
overview: Two children, raised in total isolation by an automated house, begin to confront the mysteries of their existence after an enigmatic stranger arrives from outside.

title: Fake Hundreds
overview: After a cancer diagnosis, a man tries to confront God.

title: Days that Shocked the World: Concorde Crash
original_title: Days that Shocked the World: Concorde Crash
overview: Concorde was an icon of the skies, but on 25 July 2000, Air France Flight 4590 left Paris for New York and caught fire during take-off before crashing to the ground just over a minute later, killing everyone on board. The tragedy brought an end to the dream of supersonic passenger flight. But what caused the disaster? Investigators, survivors’ loved ones and those who examined the wreckage recall the tragedy and describe how the evidence led to a shockingly simple conclusion about what went wrong.

title: Amy Winehouse: The Tragic Downfall
overview: A documentary that delves into the life, career, and struggles of iconic British singer and songwriter Amy Winehouse. Through the archival footage, interviews with those who knew her and expert analysis, the film explores Amy's quick rise to fame, her battles with addiction and mental health issues, and the pressure of celebrity culture. It offers a poignant reflection on the music industry's impact on artists and devastating consequences of unchecked fame.

title: Splash City
overview: Two brothers on diverging paths struggle to survive amidst the pressures of their community.

title: Prompt: Make a Documentary
overview: Prompt: Make a Documentary investigates the growing influence of artificial intelligence on the film industry.  The documentary places the rise of AI within the broader historical context of cinema’s evolution, drawing parallels with earlier technological shifts such as the introduction of sound, colour, and digital visual effects. By revisiting landmark moments in film history, the film demonstrates that disruption has always been part of cinema’s DNA, while questioning whether AI represents a fundamentally different kind of change.  Featuring insights from directors, academics, and practitioners, Prompt: Make a Documentary explores the tension between innovation and integrity, the democratisation of creative tools, and the ethical implications of automation in the arts. The film ultimately asks whether artificial intelligence will empower the next generation of storytellers or redefine creativity itself.

title: EZ Driver
overview: Miguel Matias, a laid-back EZ driver coasting through life, hits an unexpected breaking point when he picks up Ruby Valentine, a suspicious passenger with secrets that attract the wrong kind of attention. What begins as a routine ride escalates into a dangerous chain reaction that pulls Miguel into her trouble, forcing him to navigate rising threats, split-second choices, and a night that pushes him far beyond his comfort zone.

title: The Dendrill
overview: While preparing their childhood home for sale, Mark reunites with his estranged stepbrother, Francis, who insists the forest never forgot them.

title: Operation Kino
overview: A trio of thieves infiltrate a movie theater to obtain an object

title: Motel Inn
overview: Daniel has worked at a motel for years. He has seen a range of strange guests enter and leave; these four have been the strangest.

title: Dagnabbit!
overview: A homeowner. A crawlspace. An unwanted guest.

title: Taboo Cocoon
overview: The life of a hypochondriacal Internet musician takes a turn for the worse after an unexpected reunion with a childhood best friend runs parallel to a wave of mass killings.

title: The Odyssey
overview: Odysseus, the legendary King of Ithaca, embarks on a long and perilous journey home following the Trojan War. Throughout his voyage, he is forced to confront the whims of gods, mythological monsters, and trials that stretch both his cunning and his humanity to the breaking point.

title: Teeth of A Fawn
overview: Bea can’t breathe when her girlfriend’s away.

title: The Cocaine Diaries
overview: Two incompetent teenagers, Sammy and Tim, are entrusted with a bag of cocaine to keep safe for the day. To them it seems simple, that is until they begin to realise that everyone and everything seems to be trying their best to get in their way.

title: How to Trick Your Way onto the Property Ladder
original_title: How to Trick Your Way onto the Property Ladder
overview: Oobah masterminds a range of stunts and tricks designed to get two young first time buyers onto the increasingly elusive first rung of the property ladder – eventually achieving just that.

title: O Little Christmas Market
overview: An artist's fights to saves her town's beloved Christmas market from a developer but a budding romance with the architect tied to the deal may help bring about a Christmas miracle.

title: DETAIL THE HUMAN OPERA
overview: Ramiel is on the subway with his girlfriend when he sees someone from his past on an adjacent running train. He decides to get some closure.

title: Wildman
overview: An aloof young man escapes to the wilds of Yosemite in the throes of a depressive episode. His only companion is a camera.

title: Niple
overview: Insecure Danny is trying to reinvent himself as a trendsetting nonconformist—but his plans are derailed by a grotesquely swollen, leaking nipple he refuses to have medically treated. As job interviews implode, dates curdle, and strangers recoil, Danny clings to the idea that his “condition” is just another sign he’s ahead of the curve.

title: The Third Degree
overview: Four young actors in London rehearse an upcoming West End play when their secret affairs with one another become revealed. In twist after twist, they try to outwit each other which soon spirals into murderous consequences.

title: Artichoke
overview: Held captive in a violent relationship, Cynara discovers a phoropter that opens a portal to another world. In a terrifying cat-and-mouse chase between realities, Cynara finally comes face to face with her oppressor and must decide what she’s willing to destroy in order to survive.

title: NAXOS
overview: On a research trip to Greece, Adam slips into a parallel life without marriage, children, or responsibility. With Nysa, a local, he drifts through enchanted freedom while haunted by the life he once took for granted.

title: Lads Being Lads
overview: The series follows four close friends who live in the all too depressing yet fictional village of Greyville, Ireland. The kind of place you would expect barely anything to happen. But for Eoin McGintley, Patrick Quinn, James Dames, and Marky Mac, the four of whom are just trying to find some adventure and a few laughs, it becomes the epicentre for their many outright whacky and foolish shenanigans as the lads try to just have fun with what little youth they have left now that adulthood lies closer around the corner for this group of immature teens.

title: If You Can Make It Here
original_title: If You Can Make It Here
overview: Kingsley, Kevin, and Hailey are three ambitious eighth graders preparing for a single exam that could determine their futures. They’re competing for admission to New York City’s Specialized High Schools, elite public institutions that have produced Nobel Prize laureates, astronauts, judges, artists, and national leaders. But as the kids await their test results, a citywide battle is raging over who should attend these schools—the kids who score highest on the entrance exam or the kids who improve diversity. Featuring interviews with kids, parents, and education leaders, If You Can Make It Here places young students at the center of a high-stakes cultural conflict over the future of equity and excellence in public education.

title: You'll Never Believe Who's Dead
overview: As the Cosgrove family gather for a traditional Irish Christmas, and their financial problems come to the fore, a solution presents itself in the form of a robbery of local reclusive farmer Charlie Bann. But the Cosgrove’s have bitten off more than they can chew, as Charlie Bann is not who he seems to be…

title: Rabbit on a Highway
overview: A neurotic, alcoholic trans man struggles through navigating his social and love life.

title: The Waiting Man
overview: In 2022, the famous streaming group TOMNI was at the height of its popularity with over 7 million followers. Over the course of a week, their content changed and then they suddenly vanished. This is the footage recovered from their social media, computers, and SD cards. Experts believe the footage shows the worldwide phenomenon known as Alikabiha, also called the Waiting Man.

title: Urchins
overview: Follows a college freshman as they embark on a road trip with new friends, finding a renewed life purpose.

title: Do Stars Know Fear?
overview: Trapped operative confronts cunning foil amid tense, futuristic space hemisphere.

title: Demon Hunter: Time 2 Kill
overview: On the hunt to find the pieces of a medallion that can end the demonic control over Earth, Taryn is forced to go through time to save the future.

title: EXAMSTRESS
overview: Examstress is a short student film created for college, year 2/2. This film is about the stress of exams and typical student mental health during this time. It follows Penn, a procrastinating student, as they work towards their final major project.

title: Our House
overview: Three estranged siblings reunite at the family home for their late mother’s wake, prompting an inheritance battle that turns deadly.

title: Boy
overview: While housesitting alone, Danny invites an older stranger over for a casual hookup. The charged encounter pushes Danny out of his comfort zone and into a world of confusion, forcing him to face the mismatch of who he is and who he appears to be.

title: Daisy
overview: Curiosity gets the better of a whimsical girl when Daisy washes ashore...

title: Solitaire
overview: A young woman adjusts to life in a new city, managing remote work, a relationship on thin ice, and single-player tennis.

title: Two Pids
overview: After the world premiere of Being John Smith at the Toronto Film Festival a strange experience in the filmmaker’s hotel causes him to ponder the nature of reality.

title: Summer's Last Resort
overview: Determined to save her mom from another bad relationship, a teen accidentally turns a luxury vacation into total chaos.

title: Night of the Living Dead
overview: A ragtag group barricade themselves in an old Pennsylvania farmhouse to remain safe from a horde of flesh-eating ghouls ravaging the Northeast.

title: How They Really Are
overview: A boy named Tyler Ortin is struggling with lonlieness and the problem of his parents constant fighting when he becomes friends with a classmate Louey. Tyler helps his class get their grades back on track but the stress catches up to him.

title: The Bay
overview: Best friends Emma and Lani, attending a destination wedding in Thailand, find themselves trapped on a sinking tour boat in the heart of a tiger shark sanctuary.

title: 'Mr. Paradise'
overview: Rejected by the person he changed for, Tyler Terry, a picture-perfect boy must become who he truly is after losing himself to being someone else's paradise.

title: Life Coach
overview: A lonely Muay Thai instructor (Mark Bale) seeks self-confidence through an online life-coaching app, gradually surrendering control to an unseen mentor.

title: Louis C.K.: Ridiculous
overview: From a bee getting shot in New York City to paying strangers to take his aging father, Louis C.K. unleashes the ridiculous thoughts in his mind.

title: Guided by Horses
overview: In the stunning beauty of the Kimberley, this feature length documentary is a cinematic story of hope, rising from the quiet, unexpectedly powerful bond between a cast of young people and horses, who are participating in a uniquely special sanctuary created by Aboriginal researcher Professor Juli Coffin.

title: Fox & the Tiny Demon
overview: Qaqsoss naka Wahantuhsis is an animated allegory about Qaqsoss, a fox who is haunted by Wahantuhsis, a tiny demon. Set in an enchanted forest, the film explores themes of mental illness, trauma, and generational pain through Qaqsoss' struggles with both her inner demons and the mischievous demon that follows her. As Qaqsoss faces her fears, she discovers resilience and growth. Ultimately, the story intertwines Indigenous culture and personal experience, showcasing the importance of self-healing and the understanding of others. The film, told in Wolastoqey, is a poignant exploration of survival and connection.

title: Landship
overview: The Battle of Passchendaele, 1917. For three years the great war has been waging, and the two armies find themselves entrenched along the four-hundred-mile Western Front. At the start of a pivotal allied offensive to break the stalemate, the nine-man crew of a British MKIV Tank set out to destroy a series of heavily defended German bunkers.

title: Before I Do
overview: A lakeside bachelor party weekend devolves into chaos when the groom, John Michael, and his best man, Alex, find their past romantic feelings reigniting. Their chemistry entangles the entire wedding party in pre-wedding drama, including friends Luís, Simon, and the newly out and bisexual Kit.

title: Blood Orange
overview: An anxious woman goes about her day as normal, but nothing seems to be going her way.

title: Satisfaction Guaranteed
overview: Marcus, a customer service agent whose job is to help anyone with anything with the aid of Assist-O, a hyper-efficient AI assistant. When the tasks become increasingly bizarre and Assist-O starts taking things too far, Marcus struggles to maintain control, revealing the chaos and absurdity lurking behind the promise of perfect service.

title: Lucky Strike
overview: A wounded American soldier fights to survive behind enemy lines during WWII's Battle of the Bulge against the Germans, relying on his instinct, spy craft and a hand-radio to evade capture and find his way back to his unit.

title: Cherry B
overview: It’s 1969, a housewives soiree, drinking cocktails whilst summoning up an old dead friend. When a spiritual message prompts adolescent Lilith to respond, it alerts us to the demon that lies within.

title: Meeting the Buddha
overview: Meeting the Buddha presents the life and legacy of the 16th Karmapa, Rangjung Rigpe Dorje—the head of the Karma Kagyu lineage, one of four main schools of Tibetan Buddhism. The film captures the remarkable presence of this spiritual teacher, known as a Living Buddha and the King of the Yogis.  We meet Ole Nydahl, a wild young hippy from Denmark who, as a small child, had declared his wish to become the "Danish champion of mind." His life is radically transformed by a chance encounter with the Karmapa in Nepal in 1969.  Ole and his wife, Hannah, become key figures in bringing Tibetan Buddhism to the West, founding hundreds of meditation centres—from Mexico City to Vladivostok—and carrying forward their teacher's vision with unshakable dedication.

title: Good Vibes Only
overview: A woman desperately wants to cry following a painful breakup. But her AI companion won't let her.

title: Return to Your Dreams
overview: Waking up from a dream he can’t seem to forget, Faizan struggles to maintain the newly structured life he’s built for himself, dazed and lost in thought. And as more memories from his past continue to resurface, he soon learns that the nightmarish ones still refuse to let him go.

title: Truly Mine
overview: Leila, an 18-year-old girl who is on the brink of adulthood. As the pressure of her family's expectations grows, Leila has to choose between a life laid out for her or freedom, risking everything she loves for a life that's truly hers.

title: The Hole
overview: Despite living mere feet from one another, downstairs neighbor SYBIL and upstairs neighbor HUGO have never met. But worlds collide when a hole is cut open between their units to address a plumbing leak. Yearning for connection, Sybil can't resist climbing through the hole to spy on Hugo -- an act that will ultimately lead to broken bones and an unlikely friendship.

title: Make Sense
overview: Michelin-star-winning master chef Michael Bringalow adds an autumnal soup to his menu.

title: Julián
overview: Wide-eyed Julián is about to spend the summer with a grandmother he barely knows. He is amazed to discover her treasure-trove apartment, his own Caribbean heritage and the lively Brooklyn community he is surrounded by. But most surprising of all, Julián discovers that he is, in fact, a mermaid!

title: A Deadline Movie
overview: A group of college students travel back in time to submit their late assignment

title: ZsaZsa Zaturnnah vs The Amazonistas of Planet X
original_title: ZsaZsa Zaturnnah vs The Amazonistas of Planet X
overview: Ada is a shy gay man living in a small town in the Philippines. After many heartbreaks over many years, he has committed himself to a simple and single life. But when a magical stone from outer space transforms him into a flamboyant female superhero, Ada is forced to face fantastic challenges. From fighting zombies to stopping invading Amazonistas from Planet X, to the even more difficult task of risking his heart to love again.

title: I’d Rather Be a Concorde
overview: An immigrant saying "Hello" to unknown lands. A recreation of old fantasy video games through irony, in which the protagonist and his Wizard guide companion, face strange situations that allude to the absurd nature of the immigrant's journey.

title: Invisible Harvests
overview: A tactile, stop-motion poem built from decayed 16mm film, dried kombucha SCOBYs, and bubbling ferments. Treating animation as a process of transformative decay, the film traces inherited rituals and the residue of care. It attends to what persists as memory and language fade.

title: Danse macabre
overview: An apocalyptic nightmare about war and destruction, set to the Allegro from Shostakovich' 10th symphony.

title: THE CAGE WITHIN
overview: A true fight isn’t fought in the ring, but inside the mind.  The Cage Within follows Jake, a young fighter struggling with anger, trauma and the weight of expectations, as he tries to break the cycle of violence that shaped him. Between training, silence and fractured relationships, the film observes a man who chooses not to become what hurt him — even when that choice hurts more.  An intimate, restrained drama about masculinity, control and the quiet cost of change.

title: Beliath
overview: What begins as a routine crime report soon spirals into a descent through eerie folklore, buried cults, and unsettling discoveries that blur the line between journalism and obsession.

title: Show Me the Line
overview: When an Alabama ruling disrupts access to IVF, acclaimed journalist and visual artist Abbey Crain has already been in fertility treatment for over 5 years. Overnight, her dreams of motherhood—and her embryos—are out of reach. But Crain refuses to surrender her creative power. With a pen and paintbrush, she embarks on a journey to honor fellow patients. Driven to celebrate portraits of everyday people and amplify their unheard stories of joy, anguish, beauty, and determination, Crain connects with a group of remarkable women. Together, they cultivate hope from the unsettled landscape that overlooked them.

title: So Be It
overview: Five senior LGBTQIA+ couples share their resilient love stories, reflecting on identity, aging, and love while offering younger generations inspiring role models.

title: Prurience Executed
overview: A sexually obsessed and oppressed priest stalks a group of four young women in a park and watches them perform a pagan ritual. Eventually, his arousal for the women turns to hatred and he attacks. The women are left with no choice but to defend themselves.

title: Oliver West
overview: West Knight secretly helps Oliver, a ghost only she can see, cross over to the afterlife before his spiritual essence deteriorates completely. While her step sibling Jaime navigates a new romance with coworker Quinn, West discovers that Oliver's unfinished business isn't about supernatural rituals—it's about experiencing human connection and love.

title: Goodbye to All That
overview: In a dusty apartment, Gabo mourns the end of a difficult relationship. Soon, reality gives way to a dreamlike delirium…

title: Stepfather
overview: After years of eradicating any family that falls short of perfection, Darnell believes his new wife Asia and her daughters might finally be the real deal. That is, until tensions rise and they uncover his deadly pattern. Now, getting rid of them won’t be as easy as he planned.

title: Four Itchy Boys
overview: Four young men quarantined for a unexplainable, unrelenting itch prepare for a live-stream press event to prove they’re not the monsters the world believes them to be. But behind the scenes, a ruthless producer is plotting a more grotesque spectacle.

title: Peace Corps
overview: Drifting directionlessly around her hometown after unexpectedly being dismissed early from a stint in the Peace Corps, a 30-year-old Asian American woman butts heads with her mother, goes on an ill-advised date with a figure from her past, and ruminates on the meaning of her life.

title: The Pink Funeral
overview: A transgender Chinese girl on the brink of crossing over to the afterlife embarks on a comedic struggle back on Earth to ensure the proper burial of her body, ultimately leading to a profound reconciliation with her mother and acceptance of her true identity.

title: The Gilded Mirror
overview: The Gilded Mirror follows Charles Randolph, a once-renowned performer haunted by his wife’s death. When a young woman comes to audition for him, their encounter reveals a charade of illusion and obsession.

title: Symbiosis
overview: A weekend reunion at an isolated house turns sinister when old friends realise their host, and the house itself, may want more than their company.

title: Finding Joy
overview: Roni Gingrich is a PTSD survivor and aspiring artist whose buried childhood trauma manifests in the form of sleep paralysis and recurring dreams as she unravels the truth of her past.

title: AM/FM
overview: A recluse virtual DJ and his obsessive listener are pulled together by an eerie radio signal—both yearning for a connection they can’t describe.

title: Bodyhackers
overview: An environmental activist Denver Blake has decided to expose a cosmetics corporation that he believes is exploiting the insecurities caused by societal beauty standards. However, when he falls in love with Renée, a former ballerina obsessed with constantly improving her beauty, he becomes drawn into a mesmerizing underworld of plastic surgery.

title: He Drinks a Lager Drink
overview: An anthology film sequel to Meldrum and Rea's No Bummer Summer. A carefully curated dive into the idyllic-though-hedonistic ways of the boys of the summer.

title: The Legend of Yella George
overview: A man's wife mysteriously goes missing one night. All evidence points towards the husband. As detectives dive deeper into the case, a local legend begins to twist itself into the case, confusing detectives and the husband. Nightmares, death, and mystery surround this story with an ending no one could see coming.
